mapper.sql: cms_topic.status = 1 and cms_topic.user_status = 1 and cms_topic.del_flag = 0 and cms_topic.is_template = 0 and coalesce(cms_topic.club_member_only, 0) = 0 and and (cms_topic.club_id is null or cms_topic.club_id = 0 or exists ( select 1 from club active_club where active_club.id = cms_topic.club_id and active_club.del_flag = 0 ))

cms_activity.status = 1 and cms_activity.publish_status = 1 and cms_activity.del_flag = 0 and cms_activity.cancel_time is null and and (cms_activity.club_id is null or cms_activity.club_id = 0 or exists ( select 1 from club active_club where active_club.id = cms_activity.club_id and active_club.del_flag = 0 )) and not exists ( select 1 from cms_topic parent_topic left join club parent_club on parent_club.id = parent_topic.club_id and parent_club.del_flag = 0 where parent_topic.id = cms_activity.topic_id and parent_topic.club_id is not null and parent_topic.club_id != 0 and parent_club.id is null ) and not exists ( select 1 from cms_topic member_only_parent where member_only_parent.id = cms_activity.topic_id and coalesce(member_only_parent.club_member_only, 0) = 1 )

p.lifecycle = 'PUBLISHED' and p.audience = 'PUBLIC' and p.search_eligible = 1 and exists ( select 1 from community_search_document post_sd where post_sd.document_type = 'POST' and post_sd.document_id = p.id and post_sd.visibility_state = 'VISIBLE' )
mapper.insert: insert into content_search_document (document_type, document_id, title, search_text, img_url, city_code, visibility_state, source_time, indexed_at) select 'TOPIC', cms_topic.id, left(cms_topic.name, 200), concat_ws(' ', cms_topic.name, cms_topic.address_name, left(cms_topic.description, 2000)), left(cms_topic.img_url, 500), cms_topic.city_code, 'VISIBLE', cms_topic.create_time, #{now} from cms_topic where on duplicate key update title = values(title), search_text = values(search_text), img_url = values(img_url), city_code = values(city_code), visibility_state = values(visibility_state), source_time = values(source_time), indexed_at = values(indexed_at)

insert into content_search_document (document_type, document_id, title, search_text, img_url, city_code, visibility_state, source_time, indexed_at) select 'ACTIVITY', cms_activity.id, left(cms_activity.name, 200), concat_ws(' ', cms_activity.name, cms_activity.address_name, left(cms_activity.description, 2000)), left(cms_activity.img_url, 500), cms_activity.city_code, 'VISIBLE', cms_activity.create_time, #{now} from cms_activity where on duplicate key update title = values(title), search_text = values(search_text), img_url = values(img_url), city_code = values(city_code), visibility_state = values(visibility_state), source_time = values(source_time), indexed_at = values(indexed_at)

insert into content_search_document (document_type, document_id, title, search_text, img_url, city_code, visibility_state, source_time, indexed_at) select 'POST', p.id, left(coalesce(nullif(p.title, ''), p.body), 200), concat_ws(' ', p.title, left(p.body, 2000)), null, p.city_code, 'VISIBLE', coalesce(p.published_at, p.create_time), #{now} from community_post p where on duplicate key update title = values(title), search_text = values(search_text), img_url = values(img_url), city_code = values(city_code), visibility_state = values(visibility_state), source_time = values(source_time), indexed_at = values(indexed_at)
mapper.update: update content_search_document d set d.visibility_state = 'HIDDEN', d.title = null, d.search_text = '', d.img_url = null, d.indexed_at = #{now} where d.document_type = 'TOPIC' and d.visibility_state = 'VISIBLE' and not exists (select 1 from cms_topic where cms_topic.id = d.document_id and )

update content_search_document d set d.visibility_state = 'HIDDEN', d.title = null, d.search_text = '', d.img_url = null, d.indexed_at = #{now} where d.document_type = 'ACTIVITY' and d.visibility_state = 'VISIBLE' and not exists (select 1 from cms_activity where cms_activity.id = d.document_id and )

update content_search_document d set d.visibility_state = 'HIDDEN', d.title = null, d.search_text = '', d.img_url = null, d.indexed_at = #{now} where d.document_type = 'POST' and d.visibility_state = 'VISIBLE' and not exists (select 1 from community_post p where p.id = d.document_id and )
mapper.sql: case d.document_type when 'TOPIC' then current_topic.city_code when 'ACTIVITY' then current_activity.city_code when 'POST' then current_post.city_code end
mapper.select: select lower(d.document_type) as type, d.document_id as id, d.title as name, d.title as title, d.img_url as imgUrl, as cityCode, d.source_time as sourceTime from content_search_document d left join cms_topic current_topic on d.document_type = 'TOPIC' and current_topic.id = d.document_id left join cms_activity current_activity on d.document_type = 'ACTIVITY' and current_activity.id = d.document_id left join community_post current_post on d.document_type = 'POST' and current_post.id = d.document_id where d.visibility_state = 'VISIBLE' and d.document_type in #{type} and d.search_text like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') escape '\\' and = #{cityCode} and ( (d.document_type = 'TOPIC' and exists ( select 1 from cms_topic where cms_topic.id = d.document_id and )) or (d.document_type = 'ACTIVITY' and exists ( select 1 from cms_activity where cms_activity.id = d.document_id and )) or (d.document_type = 'POST' and exists ( select 1 from community_post p where p.id = d.document_id and and not exists (select 1 from im_block b where (b.member_id = #{viewerId} and b.blocked_member_id = p.author_id) or (b.member_id = p.author_id and b.blocked_member_id = #{viewerId})) and not exists (select 1 from community_member_mute mu where mu.member_id = #{viewerId} and mu.muted_member_id = p.author_id))) ) order by d.source_time desc, d.id desc
